coverage_status_note: Sites located through their serving utilities, and claims read from its own filings.

sites.note: Detector rank 6. Dominion Virginia Power provides retail service to AWS's Northern Virginia data centers. NOVEC also serves parts of the region; sites outside Dominion territory are NOT covered by this row.

Separate row on purpose: NOVEC is a different serving utility from Dominion in the same metro and is building substation capacity outside Dominion's territory for AWS. Same BA/zone footprint, different retail provider.
confidence=high. I&M's own release names the AWS New Carlisle campus among the large loads its settlement is designed to serve; I&M is in PJM's AEP zone.
confidence=high. Entergy's own blog describes Amazon's Madison County data center expansion as load Entergy Mississippi is preparing to serve.
confidence=high. AWS's own page names Umatilla Electric Cooperative as the electric cooperative serving AWS in Umatilla and Morrow Counties; UEC sits inside BPA's balancing authority.

confidence=medium. POWER reports PPL Electric Utilities delivers the power to Amazon's Susquehanna-adjacent campus in Salem Township and places it in PJM's PPL zone. Note this site sits next to the Susquehanna nuclear plant under a Talen PPA; a nuclear PPA is a contract, not a separate grid.
confidence=medium. The Inquirer states the Falls Township data center lies in PECO's service territory within PJM and cites a PECO / Amazon Data Services transmission service agreement at FERC.

claims.note: No intra-document finding. Amazon's headline 100%-matched claim is on page 5 inside an infographic, which extracts as fragments ('100% matched 100% matched') rather than a sentence. A quotable restatement does exist on page 10 and is used for the cross-document check, but nothing in the report qualifies or undercuts it in the same sentence, so nothing is reported.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
Site mapping is hand-curated from serving utilities, never inferred from state.
Annual matched claims are TRUE under the GHG Protocol market-based method. The verdict is 'true on paper, X physically', not an accusation.
Every quote was read off the rendered PDF page or raw SEC HTML by a human.
